description:
`raise MyApp.NotThere, "x"` is refused with the error pointing at `runtime:Kernel.fz:200:21`, the `quote` inside the `raise` macro, a line the reader did not write. A user macro does the same: with `defmacro bad(x), do: quote(do: String.nope(unquote(x)))`, a call `Mac.bad("x")` reports `resolve/unknown-import` at the `quote` line of the macro, not at the call.

Elixir gives quoted code the caller's line unless the quote says `location: :keep`.

Proposal page first: where quoted nodes get their spans during expansion, and what a diagnostic should show (the call site, with the macro's line as a note).
title: An error in code a macro quoted is reported where the macro was called
